description: Write the supporting guides as ex_doc extras, built from existing material without duplicating it: Getting started (install as a dependency, path/git/Mix.install, the C compiler requirement, first kernel, calling it, reading a compile error); Testing kernels (Elixir mode as the oracle, assert_agrees, agreement properties, forced yields); Measuring (from examples/README.md Measuring correctly and the verdict rules: optimise Elixir first); The runtime contract (yielding, safepoints, failure isolation, what a kernel can and can't do to the VM; from docs/beam-nifs.md and README); Deploying (mix release, C compiler at build time per ADR 0002, examples/release_debian, defk-n8f's outcome); a cheatsheet (.cheatmd) of types, builtins and common rewrites. Decide whether docs/language.md stays one page or is split into several (types, expressions, arrays, control flow, calls, yielding, Elixir mode) with stable anchors; keep the docs example test covering every page.
title: Guides: getting started through deployment
